tables.name: Merchant District Additional Locations
tables.description: Rolled for each additional location of a Merchant district (Very Small 1 … Very Large 5 per district). 1 and 20: roll again, the next location a step down or up in quality.

results.name: Roll Again (a step down in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step down in quality.

results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Alchemist
results.description: (Specialty) Brews and sells potions, as well as mundane herbs and alchemical ingredients.

results.name: Artist
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses painter, sculptor or other visual art as appropriate.

results.name: Bank & Exchange
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses auctions, banking, and the specific selling of gems or exchange of currency.

results.name: Cobbler
results.description: (Specialty) Makes and mends boots and shoes.

results.name: Luxury Furnishings
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells all manner of home items for fine living, including furniture, art, and other high-quality goods.

results.name: Rare Libations & Fare
results.description: (Exotic) Sells (and, perhaps, makes or brews) drinks and/or food of surpassing quality or rarity to the region.

results.name: Rare Trade Goods
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells items and materials, such as ores or textiles, that are rare to the region.

results.name: Magic Shop
results.description: (Exotic) A magic shop; its specialization is rolled.

results.name: Barber
results.description: Provides grooming services, such as haircuts or shaves.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Inn
results.description: Provides accommodation, as well as a place to have a bath and a decent meal.

results.name: Club
results.description: Provides entertainment via comedic, dramatic or musical performance.

results.name: Hired Help
results.description: Hired help; its kind is rolled (1d10), then its size.

results.name: Roll Again (a step up in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step up in quality.
